title: Toxicological investigation of mycotoxin contaminants and antibiotic residues associated with the poultry industry and their impact on human health
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23354-23369
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00856A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jahida Akter, Kabir Hossain, Santanu Deb Nath, Hozzatul Islam, Khaleda Afrin, Hamida Begum, Monir Uzzaman
This study shows the bioaccumulation of mycotoxin contaminants and antibiotic residues in poultry products. It highlights their biological hazards and associated toxicological risks to human health through the food chain.
